blocks.prompt: 10 Consider a parallelepiped determined by the vectors \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 5\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = 4\underline{i} - 7\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\). If the base of the parallelepiped is defined by the vectors \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\), then find the height of the parallelepiped.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh height (unchai) ka sawal hai. Har dabbe ke liye volume \(=\) base ka area \(\times\) height.
Diya kya hai? Teen edges \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}, \underline{w}\), aur yeh ke base \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) se bana hai.
Find kya karna hai? Us base ke upar dabbe ki height.
Rule kaunsa? Base area \(= |\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\), volume \(= |[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]|\).
Plan: pehle cross product aur us ki lambai (base area), phir volume, aur aakhir mein height \(=\) volume \(\div\) area.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 5\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 4\underline{i} - 7\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\); base \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}\) par.
Humein find karna hai: height \(h\).
Tareeqa: \(h = \dfrac{|\underline{w} \cdot (\underline{u} \times \underline{v})|}{|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|}\). Kyun? \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) base ke perpendicular (normal) hai. Height \(\underline{w}\) ka woh hissa hai jo is normal ki simt mein hai, yani \(\underline{w}\) ka projection: \(|\underline{w} \cdot (\underline{u} \times \underline{v})| \div |\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\). Yahi volume \(\div\) area bhi hai.

\(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) nikalein
\[\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 2 & 4 & -3 \\ 5 & -3 & 6 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (24 - 9)\underline{i} - (12 + 15)\underline{j} + (-6 - 20)\underline{k}\]
\[= 15\underline{i} - 27\underline{j} - 26\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\) ka minor \((4)(6) - (-3)(-3) = 24 - 9 = 15\). \(\underline{j}\) ka minor \((2)(6) - (-3)(5) = 12 + 15 = 27\), minus sign ke saath \(-27\). \(\underline{k}\) ka minor \((2)(-3) - (4)(5) = -6 - 20 = -26\).
Dhyan dein: \((-3)(-3) = +9\), is liye \(24 - 9\); yahan \(24 + 9\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Base ka area
\[|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}| = \sqrt{15^2 + 27^2 + 26^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{225 + 729 + 676} = \sqrt{1630}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) par bane parallelogram ka area \(|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\) hai. Lambai ke formula mein har component ka square (negative ka square bhi positive) jama kar ke root liya. \(1630 = 2 \times 5 \times 163\), is mein koi perfect square factor nahi, is liye \(\sqrt{1630}\) waisa hi rahega.

Volume
\[\underline{w} \cdot (\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) = 60 + 189 + 52 = 301\]
Kyun: \((4)(15) = 60\), \((-7)(-27) = 189\), \((-2)(-26) = 52\). Volume \(|301| = 301\) cubic units. Cross product pehle hi nikal chuka tha, is liye poora determinant dobara banane ki zaroorat nahi; bas \(\underline{w}\) se dot kar diya.

Height
\[h = \dfrac{301}{\sqrt{1630}} = \dfrac{301\sqrt{1630}}{1630}\]
\[\approx 7.46 \text{ units}\]
Kyun: Volume \(=\) area \(\times\) height, to height \(=\) volume \(\div\) area. Doosri shakal mein denominator ko rationalize kiya (upar neeche \(\sqrt{1630}\) se multiply). Dono shaklein sahi hain; answer key pehli shakal deti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\underline{u} \cdot (\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) = 30 - 108 + 78 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[\sqrt{1630} \approx 40.37,\ 40.37 \times 7.46 \approx 301 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Cross product dono vectors ke perpendicular hona chahiye; \(\underline{u}\) ke saath dot 0 aaya, to cross product sahi hai. Aur area \(\times\) height wapas volume 301 de raha hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein "determined by the vector" aur "is define by the vectors" chhapa hai; durust "determined by the vectors" aur "is defined by the vectors" hai. Yeh sirf zabaan ki ghalti hai; data aur jawab par koi asar nahi.
